scientific_integrity: Exhaustive calculations independently performed with two separately implemented algorithms; finite proof is conditional on checking supplied code; no external independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The exact shortest-length formula is established by exhaustive finite analysis only for n=3,...,24; its continuation beyond n=24 is unproved. The run-threshold and explicit upper bound have proofs for all n>=3. Bibliographic search cannot rule out unindexed earlier tables.
title: Bounded-run synchronization of the Černý automata through order twenty-four
